question:
In figure a, the pain and temperature sensory pathway is depicted. The first-order neuron enters the spinal cord and forms a synapse with the second-order neuron, whose axon ends in the thalamus. The third-order neuron transmits the information to the brain cortex. Figure b shows the vibration and proprioception (joint position) sensory pathway. The axon terminals of the first-order neurons are located in the brain stem and form synapses with second-order neurons, which cross the midline and their axons end in the thalamus. Finally, the sensory information is conducted to the cortex via the third-order neurons.

Following a spinal injury, the right ventral and left dorsal sides of the white matter in the thoracolumbar spinal cord are damaged.
question_zh:
图 a 展示痛觉与温度觉感觉通路。一级神经元进入脊髓，与二级神经元形成突触，二级神经元的轴突终止于丘脑。三级神经元将信息传至大脑皮层。图 b 展示振动觉与本体感觉（关节位置觉）通路。一级神经元的轴突末梢位于脑干，与二级神经元形成突触；二级神经元交叉过中线，其轴突终止于丘脑。最后，感觉信息经三级神经元传至皮层。

一次脊髓损伤后，胸腰段脊髓白质的右侧腹侧和左侧背侧受损。

images.caption: a: Pain and temperature pathway (crosses in the spinal cord, ascends in the anterolateral column). b: Vibration and proprioception pathway (ascends in the dorsal column, crosses in the brainstem).
images.caption_zh: a：痛觉与温度觉通路（在脊髓内交叉，经脊髓前外侧索上行）。b：振动觉与本体感觉通路（经脊髓背索上行，在脑干交叉）。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired temperature sensation in right hand.

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired vibration sensation in left leg.

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired joint position sensation in left leg and temperature sensation in right leg.
subQuestions.text_zh: 患者左腿关节位置觉和右腿温度觉均受损。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired pain sensation in left leg.

explanation:
A【错】右手的感觉纤维在颈段脊髓，胸腰段损伤不会影响手部温度觉。
B【对】左腿的振动觉/本体感觉经左侧背索同侧上行；左侧背侧白质受损，故左腿振动觉受损。
C【错】左腿关节位置觉确实受损（左背索），但右腿的痛温觉纤维在左侧脊髓交叉后经左侧前外侧索上行；左侧腹侧未受损，因此右腿温度觉不应受损。
D【对】左腿痛温觉纤维在脊髓内交叉到右侧前外侧索上行；右侧腹侧白质受损，故左腿痛觉受损。
